title_en: In the Courtroom (9/20): The Inheritance Dispute
note_en: To say "the way it used to be," Chinese wraps the comparison in a frame: 像 + model + 一样, as in 气氛已经不能像以前一样了 "things can't be the way they were anymore." 像 introduces the model and 一样 closes the frame; leaving out 一样 sounds incomplete. Note also the bookend 了 at the end, which marks a change of situation: things have now become different.
